description: Land Acquisition - Weragoda, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette notice is about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing the acquisition of a specific plot of land (0.0569 Hectare) in Weragoda village for public purposes. It includes details about the land location, survey information, and procedures for compensation claims, making it primarily focused on land and property matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
